svg.title: FIG-30 reference: finite F407 I2S2 slave TX External CK/WS; normal DMA; one complete stereo16 block Solid: required order or named branch. Dashed: retained responsibility / retry. Chip capability only; no PCB, electrical or physical HIL qualification.
svg.desc: Cold-reset Platform: no foreign running masters Own live TIM2 epoch and shared GPIOB / DMA1 gates Transmitter requires shared gates already on; Initialize one privileged task-owned transmitter Own SPI2 gate / personality, PB12 / PB13 / PB15 and vectors Caller holds CK LOW / WS HIGH through ACTIVE; ACCEPTED / QUEUED: borrow request + original whole frame Publish before request-path read-clear SR or DMA prefetch Submission success alone does not authorize CK; DMA EN → TXDMAEN → I2SE readback NDTR = N - 1 / TXE = 0; at least 3 live TIM2 ticks Acquire-observed ACTIVE alone authorizes the master; Normal master: clock declared complete stereo frames Stop before a missing next word; restart left TCIF + NDTR0 proves memory count only; DRAINING: first error remains sticky; deadline still applies TXDMAEN0 + DMA EN0, each read back Software disable may set TCIF with NDTR still nonzero; If I2SE was attempted: TXE1, then fresh BSY0 Only then clear I2SE with readback; retain quiet proof No enable attempt: serializer proof is unnecessary; Withdraw stream addresses / count / flags and both vectors Join memory, wire and reference withdrawal proofs; Detach owner references; release original whole-frame loan Final release-publish SETTLED: success whole block, error 0 B; Acquire-observe SETTLED; join external observers Transmitter stop returns pads / SPI2, preserves shared gates All shared users join before Platform stop ends epoch / gates;
